svg.title: Where the super-polynomial rate comes from
svg.desc: Left: the filter kernel |W_gamma(t)| on log-log axes, crossing the t^-2 and t^-5 guides, so its effective power grows. Right: the exponential and filter-tail summands of Psi_gamma(d).
svg.text: Two decay mechanisms, and which one survives
|W_γ(t)|, the filter kernel, and its envelope
dashed: the fixed powers t^−2 and t^−6, anchored on the envelope
No fixed power bounds it: shallower than t^−2 early, steeper
than t^−6 late. Lemma 9.1(i), independent of A8.
Ψ_γ(d) , split into its two summands
One admissible χ; Lemma 9.1 leaves χ free and the constants
depend on it. Ψ_γ is an upper bound, not a measured decay.
